evidence: evolve.py's landscape model on two squares of the design surface, with the placement the design holds: rock set down on freshly worn ground round where it came to rest, about 86% of it within 20 km, in two readings: shared in proportion to the wear, or offered so and taken only up to what each cell lost. Each cell is 1.9 km, so where on a slope the carriers set the rock is below what the model sees, and the returned rock wears as the ground does. The shares the carriers reach are the study's for lakes whose rivers bring sand. Not validated.
reading_rule: regions: for each region under the water the design gives it, each reading of the placement (shared_by_wear, no_more_than_it_lost) and each share of the rock the carriers reach, at each year: evolve.py's measures; heights, the spread of the ground over height (percentiles, the highest and the lowest); by_where_it_stood, the change of the ground that was crest, floor or between on the starting map, and of the steepest quarter; summits, the change of the thirty highest summits; the change of the rims of the largest hollows; change_m, the change of the ground by share of the land, with the most any cell rose or fell; rock, km3 cut, laid in hollows, set down and gone.
